This study evaluates **24-hour ahead hurricane intensity forecasts**, assessing whether 
additional **state variables** improve predictions beyond the **HWRF model** alone.

📌 **Key highlights:**

- Bayesian modeling of **maximum wind speed (VMAX)**  
- Feature importance analysis of **key hurricane predictors**  
- Improved accuracy over existing forecasts
